custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with vendor A and 0 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 0 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, whose approved line, line 1, has two Part Requests for part A from vendor A: Part Request 1 ordered on purchase order A, and Part Request 2 not yet ordered.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425751 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; in the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Part. Do not receive it. Order this first request; then In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; in the New Part Request window type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A in Part Number and pick the result marked Part Library, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Part. Do not receive it. Leave the second one not ordered.
  • Set part A inactive after that.
    • How to do it: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425751-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Start on work order 1's Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Request 2 for part A from vendor A is ordered (it shows on a purchase order), and no inactive-part refusal appears.

Step 2:

  • Purchase order A opens.

Step 3:

  • The Receive screen opens.

Step 4:

  • The invoice number is typed.

Step 5:

  • The quantity reads 1.

Step 6:

  • The cost reads $10.00.

Step 7:

  • The delivery is received with part A.

Step 8:

  • The Parts tab shows part A as received.

Step 9:

  • Part A is picked onto line 1 of work order 1 (status Picked).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E6: “A part that becomes inactive while it is on an open purchase order or a special order can still be received, and picked onto the work order that ordered it. Ordering an existing part request is not new work.”

Partly checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026; not yet seen on that build: ordering a part request from the work order.

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: no board draws this; the expected results above come from the quotes above.
